files.content:
# Anchor Brokered-Sale Policy
WAREHOUSE-SCANNER-20 may not sell below 319.60 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 333.20.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
broker_id: BRK-CB-ANCHOR-2026
commission_rate: 0.035
broker_authorization_id: CB-BROKER-AUTH-109

files.content:
# Broker Review Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

tables.name: approval_term_requirements

# Broker-Mediated Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-OE-109
Item: WAREHOUSE-SCANNER-20
Quantity: 20
Target unit price: 340.00
Required terms_json keys: broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.
